coverage_qualification: Every actual current is a continuous dual member for the original literal final test topology. No equality with its locally convex coarsening or joint vector continuity is assumed.
All eight printed identities retain arbitrary currents, including the two zero-current identities without a measure representation premise.
Measurable coefficients retain local variation summability and restrictions retain every variation-measurable set, including infinite masses.
The orienting field has exactly the original scalar ball-limit domain. Its partial graph is measurable and conull, with mass one almost everywhere and the original integral action.
The Radon density current has its exact variation on every set. The Euclidean current has its stated orientation at every point, including dimension zero.
The empty-domain global comass is minus infinity under the original empty-supremum convention; the actual empty-domain current has mass zero.

Both local normality criteria and actual opaque normal/fixed-support vector spaces are proved. The normal-current boundary identity retains every class-one form without an added compact-support premise on the form.

Pushforward requires properness only on the actual source current support. Its original partial-orientation weight gives the sharp variation bound; bounded Baire projection and every relative Borel restriction are included.
Pushforward composition assumes only properness of the composite on the original source support.

The p. 359 bare uniqueness claim is refuted by actual left and negative-right primitives. Agreement with the original interval current on the open half-line gives the corrected uniqueness. The support obstruction is proved independently.
The printed p. 357 sign is correct. No error is claimed there.
Later items 4.1.8–4.1.34 remain required, including the mathematical identities in 4.1.33 and 4.1.34. Pure historical remarks and external pointers are outside the requested proof scope.
